FreqUI 3.1.2 — original upstream user interface, self-hosted by WELINKBTC
==================================================================

Upstream project: https://github.com/freqtrade/frequi
Release: https://github.com/freqtrade/frequi/releases/tag/3.1.2
Commit: f76ad9e7f8b6ee8e2d1f214a484d6182393be717
License: GNU General Public License version 3. See ./LICENSE.
Original authors and copyright holders: FreqUI / Freqtrade contributors,
as identified in the corresponding source files and repository history.

This deployment uses the official freqUI.zip production release. It is the
original Vue interface, not a recreation of its dashboards or trading tools.
The upstream trading, charting, backtest, analysis, history and settings
components are retained. Original upstream data requirements and limitations
still apply; an available UI does not mean the native engine is connected.

Modifications by WELINKBTC, 2026 (host integration code: GPL-3.0-or-later):
- Asset and Vue Router bases changed to /quant-native/freqtrade/.
- Native Axios password/JWT authentication replaced at the transport boundary
  with same-origin tenant session authentication. No native password or token
  is stored in the browser. Bot selection storage keys are namespaced.
- A connection bar, access check, documented action request headers and a
  Content Security Policy restrict this deployment to its same-origin BFF.
- Original Material Design icons are preloaded through Iconify's supported
  collection/provider globals from the bundled @iconify-json/mdi 1.2.3 package.
  No external icon service is contacted. Icons are by Pictogrammers and their
  contributors; see ./MDI-LICENSE, ./MDI-APACHE-2.0.txt and ./mdi-info.json.
  The unmodified icon package is available as ./iconify-mdi-1.2.3.tgz.
- Nuxt UI's Lucide icons are likewise hosted locally from the pinned
  @iconify-json/lucide 1.2.129 package. See ./LUCIDE-LICENSE and
  ./lucide-info.json; the original package is ./iconify-lucide.tgz.
- Native bot credential form fields are hidden by host-integration.css and
  replaced with a managed-connection explanation. Trading dialogs, validation,
  views and other native forms have not been replaced.
- Startup additionally requires typing LIVE freqtrade. All commands remain
  subject to backend authentication, permission, preflight and idempotency
  checks. Unsupported operations return backend errors; no successful result
  or market/trade data is simulated by this integration.

No affiliation, endorsement, or upstream support for these host adaptations
is asserted. FreqUI is provided without warranty under its license.

Corresponding source and installation scripts are available without charge:
- ./frequi-3.1.2-upstream-source.zip — complete source for the pinned upstream
  release, including its pnpm lockfile, configuration and original LICENSE.
- ./host-integration.mjs and ./host-integration.css — complete host adapter.
- ./package-native-quant-freqtrade.mjs — complete deterministic installer and
  exact production bundle modifications, with fail-closed version checks.
- ./provenance.json — archive URLs and SHA-256 values, and per-asset original
  and deployed SHA-256 values. The unmodified official release archive can be
  obtained from the pinned releaseUrl in that manifest.

To reproduce this deployment, put the two FreqUI archives and icon files named
in provenance.json plus the host adapter/NOTICE/manifest and icon licenses in
third-party/quant-ui/freqtrade, then run
node scripts/package-native-quant-freqtrade.mjs from the repository root.
The installer is offline and never reads exchange or account credentials.
To build the upstream interface from source, extract the source archive and
follow its README using the pinned pnpm-lock.yaml and packageManager version:
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; pnpm run build. Review any rebuilt asset names
before adapting a different build; the published installer intentionally only
accepts the verified official 3.1.2 archive and its exact bundle layout.

All runtime authentication and tenant configuration remain server-side.
